description: Source code for network request and response handling in Playwright's core server, including request/response classes, cookie filtering, header management, and WebSocket handling.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and response handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, body, and timing information.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection with event handling for frames and errors.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request routing, including fulfilling, aborting, and continuing requests.

methods.name: filterCookies
methods.description: Filters cookies based on URL matching and security rules.

methods.name: isLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is local (localhost).

methods.name: applyHeadersOverrides
methods.description: Applies header overrides, filtering out forbidden headers.

methods.name: rewriteCookies
methods.description: Rewrites cookies to ensure validity and proper URL/domain assignment.

methods.name: parseURL
methods.description: Parses a string into a URL object, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: stripFragmentFromUrl
methods.description: Removes URL fragment from a URL string.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Returns the standard status text for a given HTTP status code.

methods.name: singleHeader
methods.description: Creates a headers array with a single header.

methods.name: mergeHeaders
methods.description: Merges multiple headers arrays into one, handling case insensitivity.
